deviations.what: Enter PIN / Wrong PIN are laid out from the top with the tiled keypad above 'Forgot PIN'; the c1 frames centre the column and draw no keypad
deviations.reason: The boxes need an input surface (no dead end); the c3 S15 'PIN instead · six digits' frame draws this same state with the in-app keypad, and one shared PinKeypad keeps S15, S15.3 and S0.8 from drifting. A system keyboard would also expose the PIN to third-party keyboards
deviations.authority: ADR 2026-10-05 §1 via c3/S15/PIN instead · six digits; 07 §1 rule 6 (no dead ends)

deviations.what: The next empty box is edged in primary (c3 draws it; c1 does not)
deviations.reason: Same state drawn two ways; the c3 frame's focus cue is kept as the visible-focus aid

deviations.what: Forgot PIN page has no field showing the registered number
deviations.reason: The lock mounts before any session (cold_start_gate.dart) and LockScope carries no number; inventing one is worse than leaving it out. The reset flow behind 'Send the code' owns the number. ⚠️ SPEC left at _ForgotPage

deviations.what: On a PIN-only phone the forgot page says the recovery-ladder copy (lock.forgot.body_pin_only) and the tries row says 'before the PIN switches off'
deviations.reason: A code to the number alone is not the reset on a phone with no biometric (desk 147); conservative reading (c)

deviations.what: Titles 'Unlock to open your books' / 'Enter your PIN' / 'Wrong PIN' draw in titleLarge (20 w500) where the canvas draws 17–19 px at 400–600
deviations.reason: A canvas size maps to its type role, never a literal; the nearest role to 17–19 px is section (titleLarge)

deviations.what: Filled 'Send the code' button carries the theme's rounded corners; the canvas draws it square
deviations.reason: Corner radius comes from the app-wide FilledButton theme (RkRadius.md), not this screen; changing it is foundation work for every screen at once
deviations.authority: app/lib/shared/theme.dart filledButtonTheme (tokens radius.md) — outside this lane's folders

deviations.what: Body copy (bodyLarge / bodyMedium: subtitles, the forgot-page body, status lines) draws with Material's inherited tracking — 0.5 px on bodyLarge, 0.25 px on bodyMedium — at 16 px, where the canvas sets 15.5 px untracked; the O4b subtitle wraps to four lines where the frame takes three, and the S15.3 forgot body breaks one word earlier
deviations.reason: No token defines tracking (tokens.json type.scale carries none) and RkType.body sets no letterSpacing, so ThemeData merges rkTextTheme over the M3 defaults (theme_data.dart `defaultTextTheme.merge(textTheme)`; typography.dart bodyLarge letterSpacing 0.5). The fix is one line in rkTextTheme (letterSpacing: 0 for every slot) and changes every screen at once — foundation work outside this lane's folders; overriding it per screen would hide the defect. 15.5 px maps to the body role (16 px) by rule. Open item to the theme owner (KEY145B review finding 4)
deviations.authority: app/lib/shared/theme.dart rkTextTheme — outside this lane's folders (open item); ADR 2026-10-05 §1 (tokens.json decides values: type.body 16)

deviations.what: Sealed mark at 48 px in Enter PIN / Wrong PIN where the c1 frames draw 52 px (cooldown and disabled use the c1 52 px; the face states the c3 60 px)
deviations.reason: Enter PIN / Wrong PIN are the same widget state as c3 'PIN instead · six digits' and are built to that frame (keypad, layout), which draws the mark at 48 px; one state cannot carry both sizes. Sizes come from tokens (RkSpace.s12 = 48, s12 + s1 = 52, s12 + s3 = 60)
deviations.authority: c3/S15/PIN instead · six digits (48 px); ADR 2026-10-05 §1

deviations.what: Forgot page when the gate was invalidated: inside the app (capture S15.3__forgot-reenrolled) the body says the face or fingerprint settings changed so they cannot prove it's you, and the one action is 'Prove it's you' to the S11 recovery ladder; at cold start (S15.3__forgot-reenrolled-before-open) the body says only the PIN opens the app and the books are not lost, with no action button — the back chevron returns to the PIN
deviations.reason: A biometric set changed since the PIN was set is the 06 §4.4 relative-enrols-a-face case, so code + biometric cannot be the reset; the ladder is the conservative reading, as for a PIN-only phone (desk 147). Before the app is composed no ladder entry exists, and a button that does nothing is a dead end (GATE1 review finding 2). The 'Prove it's you' label also replaces 'Send the code' on the PIN-only ladder door, which never sent a code
deviations.authority: ADR 2026-10-06 §4; 07 §1 rule 6; ⚠️ SPEC s15_lock_screen.dart header + cold_start_gate.dart (S11 entry from the cold-start S15 not built, owner item)
